item.title: QC Ware Demonstrates Hybrid Quantum-Classical Chemistry Workflow with IBM Quantum Hardware
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – QC Ware (“QC Ware” or the “Company”) today announced a technology demonstration of a hybrid quantum-classical computational chemistry workflow using Promethium® and IBM Quantum hardware. The demonstration calculated electrostatic interaction energy for nitric oxide reductase by combining GPU-accelerated molecular modeling and classical chemistry methods with quantum measurements performed on IBM’s 156-qubit Heron superconducting quantum processor.
